description: Wi-Fi in Public Space (Open Space) is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Wi-Fi in Public Space (Open Space) is an analysis of the ‘NYC Wi-Fi Hotspot Locations’ OpenData records focused on the use of Wi-Fi in open spaces (in public parks and on Governors Island). Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are broadband, public space, public wi-fi, wifi, hotspot. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI). The portal shows 2019-07-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
